title: AI Solution Developer
description:
AI Solution Developer / Architect (Azure & GenAI)

  • Contract Length: 6 months initial contract
  • IR35 Status: Outside IR35
  • Location: Remote (with occasional travel to Watford, Hertfordshire)

The Opportunity We are partnering with a globally recognized medical technology pioneer to recruit an experienced AI Solution Developer / Architect for an immediate start.

Working alongside internal engineering teams and co-engineering directly with Microsoft developers, you will be the key technical figure who "catches" an enterprise AI solution currently in build. You will absorb continuous knowledge transfer during the development phase before taking full architectural and hands-on ownership of the solution and its future iterations post-handoff.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Embed within active build sessions alongside internal engineers and the Microsoft development team to ensure seamless knowledge transfer.
  • Co-engineer, develop, and take end-to-end ownership of production-grade Generative AI applications and future iterations.
  • Design and implement agentic workflows, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, and tool/MCP integrations.
  • Establish robust evaluation frameworks to test accuracy, groundedness, and Responsible AI compliance in a regulated enterprise environment.
  • Manage data integrations and deploy scalable, secure workloads into Azure production environments.

What We Are Looking For

  • Core Engineering: Strong hands-on development skills in Python, C#, or TypeScript, backed by solid API and system integration experience.
  • GenAI & LLM Patterns: Proven experience building AI agents, orchestration workflows, prompt engineering, RAG with Azure AI Search, and tool/MCP (Model Context Protocol) integrations.
  • Microsoft AI Stack: Practical working knowledge of Microsoft Foundry (formerly Azure AI Studio) and/or Copilot Studio.
  • Evaluation & Quality: Experience creating test datasets, measuring groundedness/accuracy, and iterating on LLM outputs for production reliability.
  • Data & Cloud Deployment: Familiarity with Azure data access patterns (SQL, Cosmos DB, Microsoft Fabric) and deploying via containers or Azure App Service.
  • Production Governance: Solid grasp of Responsible AI principles, enterprise security, and observability/monitoring practices.

This is an urgent opportunity where Hiring manager is looking to interview asap. If interested then reply with a copy of your CV or send your CV to Khushoo .pandey 1 @ randstad digital .com

Randstad Technologies is acting as an Employment Business in relation to this vacancy.
